decision: Slight subjective preference for Source Sans Pro after increasing body and captions. Calm compact title and open body suit a practical service notice; material reading improvement is not established.
revision_reason: Increase body 20 to 22 and caption 16 to 18 to compensate smaller apparent size; keep title leading 1.2.
counterargument: Roboto already solves the information task; change adds no demonstrated reading-speed benefit and baseline times are somewhat heavier.
score_observations: Bilingual explanations are similarly prominent and timetable labels are easy to scan.
Open humanist forms feel welcoming without emergency urgency.
Dates and times remain prominent and columns clearly separate.
One family gives consistent forms across all roles.
